newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 18.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following business stories in its Tuesday edition:

WASHINGTON - The U.S. business community is launching a lobbying campaign to expand economic ties with China, worried that the burgeoning controversy over alleged Chinese influence buying in Washington is harming trade relations.

LOS ANGELES - Rockwell International Corp. said it plans to spin off its automotive business to shareholders, completing its transformation from a broadly diversified company to one tightly focused on electronics.

WASHINGTON - Housing Secretary Andrew Cuomo announced efforts to shut down "estate planners" who have charged hundreds of elderly Americans thousands of dollars for services that were available free from the government.
WASHINGTON - The number of lawsuits filed against lawyers has soared in recent years as competition for clients has turned the profession into an increasingly impersonal business.
